title: Finite presentations over continuous field coefficients on a noetherian base
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], a finite normed extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with noetherian underlying topological space (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention] and the coefficient ring $E_X^c=p_X^*C(-,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. There is a canonical ring-sheaf isomorphism $E_X^c\cong (V\mapsto C(|V|,E))$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, where $V$ is a pro-etale site object and $|V|$ has its Zariski topology; the right side has pointwise operations and restrictions by composition. If an $E_X^c$-module sheaf $P$ has a pro-etale covering $\{V_\alpha\to X\}$ on which it is the cokernel of a map $(E_{V_\alpha}^c)^{m_\alpha}\to(E_{V_\alpha}^c)^{n_\alpha}$ with finite nonnegative $m_\alpha,n_\alpha$, then it has a pro-etale covering $\{W_\beta\to X\}$ on which $P|_{W_\beta}\cong(E_{W_\beta}^c)^{r_\beta}$ for finite nonnegative integers $r_\beta$. In particular this assertion applies to each noetherian locally closed stratum of a module sheaf constructible in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], with strata as in [def-constructible-stratification]. No completeness condition on $P$ is assumed.
